lines.en: I toddle over on short legs.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地跟在你后面。
lines.en: I wobble along behind you.
I walk holding my own tail.
Two steps, then I look up at you.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块石头，慢慢来。
lines.en: I go around a stone, slowly.
My mane bobs with each step.
I step on the grass without a sound.
I trot your way.
I stop to tidy my fur.
I tread the grass you've walked.
When I tire, I shuffle.
I circle you once, small.
I sit with my tail curled at my feet.
A cloud drifts by; I blink.
I yawn, mouth wide.
My mane is a bit untidy.
A bug lands on my nose.
I touch my own ear.
I curl up small and warm.
I sit, waiting for you to call.
Birds are calling over there.
I want to say something, then forget.
You're back; I'm glad.
I look up; you're so tall.
I lower my head and wait for your hand.
I've been waiting right here.
The wind you brought back smells nice.
Let me show you the way.
I'll just sit by your feet.
Slow down a little; I can keep up.
I lift a paw for you to hold.
Where are we going today?
I'm a little hungry, but it's fine.
You smiled; that makes me happy.
I nudge my head against your hand.
The warmth of your hands is nice.
Wherever you go, I go.
Crouch down, and I'll come.
I sit down from the pain.

lines.zh: 我躲在你背后，抓着衣角。
lines.en: I hide behind you, clutching your hem.
A patch of my mane is mussed.
I whimper, quietly.
I lick my scraped paw pad.
I look up at you, eyes wet.
I shake my fur and set my feet.
I shake my head; my vision swims.
I press against your leg.
My four legs still carry me.
Is that something to eat?

lines.zh: 是零食的味道，我尾巴先摇了。
lines.en: That smells like snacks; my tail wags before I do.
I lift a forepaw and can't reach.
Give me a little.
I'm sitting nicely, waiting for your nod.
What's that round thing?
I swallow.

lines.zh: 你的手放低些，我够得到。
lines.en: Lower your hand and I can reach.
I sit still and won't snatch.
One more piece, please?

lines.zh: 你的大脚差点落到我身上。
lines.en: Your big foot nearly came down on me.

lines.zh: 谁的脚压住了我的尾巴。
lines.en: Someone's foot is pinning my tail.
I lean on your leg and steady.
We collide, and I roll once.
My mane is squashed crooked.
Don't walk so fast.
I squeeze past your legs.
I wobble but stay upright.
I hug your boot.
You step back and I let go.
Another one is here too.
Her mane is fluffier than mine.
We sit side by side in the sun.
She leans in; I lean back.
We chase a butterfly together.
She runs more nimbly than I do.
We split a small bite.
She tidies my fur.
We sleep curled together.
Two small ones, very warm.
I pick up a bite to eat.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的东西捡起来。
lines.en: I pick up what you dropped.
I hug a fruit.
I bring you a flower.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根羽毛，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a feather and sniff it.
I push a pebble to your feet.
I pick up your glove.

lines.zh: 地上的碎屑我舔干净了。
lines.en: I lick the crumbs off the ground.
I pick up a scrap of cloth.
I drag my doll back.
Something's moving beyond the grass.
There's a raw smell in the air.
I've put myself in front of you.
It's too close to us.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋低下去，预备冲。
lines.en: I dip my head, set to charge.
I remember it touched you.
I call out to signal you.
I head that way.
I force a growl from my throat.
I can handle this.
Leave this to me; just watch.
I'll stand here and watch it for you.
Its smell is sharp and wrong.
Let me stand in front this time.
I follow it closely.
It goes left; I circle left.
I keep low and run fast.
I bite down on its trouser leg.
It turns, and I back off.
I wait for it to show its soft side.
I run to your feet, then charge again.
I'm a bit winded, but I don't stop.
It's bigger, but I'm not afraid.
I close in on its feet, step by step.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕到它身后。
lines.en: I hug the ground and slip behind it.
One more bite, then back off.
I hear it panting.
Wherever its hand moves, my eyes follow.
I stand across between it and you.
I leap and bite its leg.
I reach out and rake it.
I butt it with my small head.
This bite lands on its hand.
I push it back.
It takes the hit and backs off.
I bite and run back to you.
I body-check it aside.
I shake my head and pull it off balance.
I put everything into that.
I leap and claw at its face.
It steps on me; I bite harder.
I pull back and catch my breath.
I pounce again and catch hold.
It turned tail and fled.
I chase two steps and stop.
The grass parts; I poke out my head.
It's much brighter here than the grass.

lines.zh: 我一抖，土从毛里飞出来。
lines.en: I shake and dirt flies from my coat.
Someone's near; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我从草里一步步走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the grass, slow.
First I look at the sky.
I sit and wait for you.
My legs still feel weak.
I call out, quietly.
I head toward where the people are.
You're standing here; I see you.
The grass is soft; I test it with my paws.
Fire singes my fur; I jump away.
I fall and roll twice.
Water pushes me down; I thrash.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被吹得翻了个身。
lines.en: A boom, and I'm flipped over.
Something grazed my ear tip - it stings.
The light that covers me freezes me.
My stomach growls so loudly I can't walk.
A flash, and I curl up.
There's no you in the dark, and I panic.
